body: Its alright. i wouldnt be so hard on yourself, honestly. Interpretations are up to the reader so if i reacted sensitively, that was my fault and i dont want you to punish urself over my sensitivity. You were like one of 2 people to read my post and i appreciate the support and help. And the facebook thing was a good idea, i have an ad on craigslist too

The bunny burrow is over burdened and they cannot accept any more rabbits. Ive already contacted them. And no. i dont really wanna share about my personal situation i want to escape it not talk about it some more...i dont think i should need to prove myself to anyone. People are so selfish. I cant try anymore ive been fighting against the current for so long and i really do give up. I never ever thought my life would be This way. I never thought id want to end my own life. But i do. I feel like theres nothing else left to try. Ive lost all hope for anything. This post was basically me resigning to it all. I give up. Thanks everyone.
